metadata.technology_specification: Automatic capsule filling machine (dosator or tamping pin technology)
metadata.technology_reasoning: Automatic capsule filling machines using dosator or tamping pin technology represent the most common industry-standard form due to their high throughput, precision filling capabilities, and widespread adoption in pharmaceutical manufacturing as of 2024. These machines accommodate a broad range of powders and pellet formulations, making them dominant in global capsule production lines.

components.reasoning: Essential module responsible for feeding empty capsules and orienting the body and cap correctly; universally present as a distinct supply chain component.
Core functional component that measures and fills powders or pellets into capsules; always separate and crucial for machine operation.
Mechanism that locks capsule caps onto bodies post-filling; typically a distinct assembly and vital for finishing capsules securely.
Transports capsules between stations accurately; commonly a modular subsystem with a separate supply chain.
Includes PLCs, sensors, and interfaces for operation control; universally present as an electronic module.
Stores and supplies powder consistently to the filling mechanism; distinct major component critical for filling accuracy.
Station that applies force to close and seal capsules; common but sometimes integrated with closing system, moderately high confidence.
Structural framework supporting all components; always present and often procured separately from electronic and mechanical modules.

Capsule Feeding and Orientation System.name: Aluminum
Capsule Feeding and Orientation System.reasoning: Used for structural parts and lightweight components due to good strength-to-weight ratio; industry standard material for mechanical parts in feeding systems.

Capsule Feeding and Orientation System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Capsule Feeding and Orientation System.reasoning: Essential for wear-resistant moving parts in contact with capsules, corrosion resistant; commonly used for hygienic and durable machine parts.

Capsule Feeding and Orientation System.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Capsule Feeding and Orientation System.reasoning: Used for some housing or guide components as a polymer due to smooth surface and durability but alternatives exist.

Filling Mechanism (Dosator or Tamping Pi.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Filling Mechanism (Dosator or Tamping Pi.reasoning: Critical for filling components in contact with powders, must resist wear and corrosion; standard material for hygienic parts.

Filling Mechanism (Dosator or Tamping Pi.name: Aluminum
Filling Mechanism (Dosator or Tamping Pi.reasoning: Used for housing or non-contact structural parts; lightweight and commonly employed but sometimes replaced by steel or polymers.

Filling Mechanism (Dosator or Tamping Pi.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Filling Mechanism (Dosator or Tamping Pi.reasoning: Possible material for some non-critical parts or coatings but less common; polymers are alternatives here.

Capsule Closing System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Capsule Closing System.reasoning: Primary material for mechanical and contact parts assuring corrosion resistance and strength in capsule closing.

Capsule Closing System.name: Aluminum
Capsule Closing System.reasoning: Used for structural or supporting frame parts where light weight is beneficial; common but substitutable.

Capsule Closing System.name: PTFE coating
Capsule Closing System.reasoning: Used as a surface treatment on moving parts to reduce friction; typical though alternatives exist.

Conveyor or Indexing System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Conveyor or Indexing System.reasoning: Widely used for conveyor frames, chains, and indexing parts needing corrosion resistance and durability.

Conveyor or Indexing System.name: Aluminum
Conveyor or Indexing System.reasoning: Used for lighter structural elements or covers; common but some parts may be steel or polymers.

Conveyor or Indexing System.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Conveyor or Indexing System.reasoning: Used for conveyor belts or rollers as polymer components; alternatives exist but common polymer choice.

Control Panel and Electronics Unit.name: Silicon

Control Panel and Electronics Unit.name: Copper
Control Panel and Electronics Unit.reasoning: Primary conductor material for circuit boards and wiring essential for electronic function.

Control Panel and Electronics Unit.name: Aluminum
Control Panel and Electronics Unit.reasoning: Used in heat sinks and casings due to good thermal conductivity and light weight but alternatives exist.

Control Panel and Electronics Unit.name: Polycarbonate
Control Panel and Electronics Unit.reasoning: Material for control panel housings and display covers due to transparency and durability; common polymer.

Powder Feeding System (Hopper and Feeder.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Powder Feeding System (Hopper and Feeder.reasoning: Crucial for hopper and feeder parts in contact with powder, corrosion resistance and cleanability required.

Powder Feeding System (Hopper and Feeder.name: Aluminum
Powder Feeding System (Hopper and Feeder.reasoning: Used for structural and supporting parts; lightweight and common though steels also used.

Powder Feeding System (Hopper and Feeder.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Powder Feeding System (Hopper and Feeder.reasoning: Possible for some hopper parts or liners; polymers offer alternatives but less standard.

Torque or Cap Locking Station.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Torque or Cap Locking Station.reasoning: Primary material for mechanical locking parts due to strength, wear and corrosion resistance.

Torque or Cap Locking Station.name: Aluminum
Torque or Cap Locking Station.reasoning: Used for lighter supporting frame components; common choice though steel preferred for durability.

Torque or Cap Locking Station.name: PTFE coating
Torque or Cap Locking Station.reasoning: Surface treatment to reduce friction in moving locking parts; typical though alternatives can be used.

Machine Frame and Enclosure.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Machine Frame and Enclosure.reasoning: Structural frame and enclosure material standard for strength, corrosion resistance, and hygiene.

Machine Frame and Enclosure.name: Aluminum
Machine Frame and Enclosure.reasoning: Used for frames and enclosures to reduce weight; common but less impact resistance than steel.

Machine Frame and Enclosure.name: Glass
Machine Frame and Enclosure.reasoning: Possible use in control panel windows or viewing sections; optional depending on design.
